checks.title: Donner B1: The Controls Change the Verdict
checks.author: Drew Wiberg
checks.passage: Scope note: This literature review compares twelve published use records for the Donner Essential B1, including its sequencer, physical controls, firmware and recording conditions. The evidence concerns the reviewers’ units and setups; it does not establish the condition of every B1 currently shipped.

checks.title: Agent Memory Now Includes Retrieval Decisions and Learned Procedures
checks.author: Drew Wiberg
checks.passage: Scope note: This review covers how seven recent preprints define, retrieve, test, and revise memory for long-running AI agents. It does not compare commercial memory products or establish one correct architecture for every agent.

checks.title: Information Governance and Knowledge Management Are Related Work
checks.author: Drew Wiberg
checks.passage: Organizations often use one word when they need three. A team asks for knowledge management because it cannot find an old decision; another asks for records management because it wants people to reuse a practical method; and the archive appears only after someone discovers that a file, project, or person’s account should have survived longer than it did.
